CAL-01.Flow: Read the calendar by day and week
CAL-01.Steps:
1. Open Calendar
2. Move between days and weeks
3. Filter by location
4. Open Requests
CAL-01.Expected result: Appointments and blocked times show on the right days and locations. Empty days show a clear message.
CAL-01.Edge cases to try: Appointment across midnight; two locations; a very busy day
CAL-01.Setup and test data: Appointments and a block from the Setup tab

CAL-02.Steps:
1. Tap an appointment
2. Review when, where, client, payment and notes
CAL-02.Expected result: Details are right. Service value, deposit due and balance due at visit add up.
CAL-02.Edge cases to try: Client with pinned notes; deposit already paid

CAL-03.Steps:
1. Choose Reschedule
2. Pick an available time
3. Save new time
CAL-03.Expected result: The appointment moves and the client is told. The old time opens up.
CAL-03.Edge cases to try: Move onto a blocked time; move to another day; move twice

CAL-04.Expected result: The appointment is cancelled, the client is told, and the time opens. The stylist sees what happens to any deposit.
CAL-04.Edge cases to try: Cancel an appointment with a paid deposit; cancel after payment
CAL-04.Setup and test data: Appointment with a Stripe test deposit

CAL-05.Flow: Mark a client as a no-show
CAL-05.Steps:
1. Open a past appointment
2. Choose More options, then Mark no show
3. Confirm
CAL-05.Expected result: The appointment shows No show and counts in the weekly no-show total. The time can be offered as an open slot.
CAL-05.Edge cases to try: No-show with a paid deposit; undo by marking complete; no-show on a future time
CAL-05.Setup and test data: An appointment whose time has passed

CAL-06.Steps:
1. Open a past appointment
2. Choose Mark complete
CAL-06.Expected result: Status becomes complete and the client can leave a review if they agreed to review requests.

CAL-07.Steps:
1. Open Add notes
2. Write notes and add photos
3. Save
CAL-07.Expected result: Notes and photos show on the visit and the client's visit history.
CAL-07.Edge cases to try: Large photo; HEIC; leave and return without saving

CAL-08.Steps:
1. Open Record pay
2. Choose Cash and confirm the amount
3. Choose Save cash payment
CAL-08.Expected result: The payment is saved as Recorded only with no Mova fee. The appointment shows paid and Money counts it under Recorded by you.
CAL-08.Edge cases to try: Amount lower than the balance; amount higher; pay twice

CAL-09.Flow: Check out with a Stripe card using the pay QR
CAL-09.Steps:
1. Choose Card, then Show a pay QR code
2. On a second device scan the QR
3. Pay with 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future date, any CVC and ZIP
CAL-09.Expected result: The client pays on their phone. The stylist's screen updates to paid. Money shows Processed by Stripe with the 1.5% Mova fee.
CAL-09.Edge cases to try: Scan twice; pay then refresh; close the client page before paying

CAL-10.Flow: Check out with a texted pay link
CAL-10.Steps:
1. Choose Card, then Text a pay link
2. Open the link on the client's phone
3. Pay with the test card
CAL-10.Expected result: The link opens a payment page for the right amount and the payment completes. If texting is not set up, the screen says so.
CAL-10.Edge cases to try: Open the link twice; open an old link
CAL-10.Setup and test data: A client with a phone you control

CAL-11.Flow: Card payment that fails then works
CAL-11.Steps:
1. Pay with 4000 0000 0000 0002 (declined)
2. See the message
3. Pay again with 4242 4242 4242 4242
CAL-11.Expected result: The decline shows a plain message and the balance stays due. The second attempt succeeds and only one payment is recorded.

CAL-12.Steps:
1. Pay with 4000 0025 0000 3155
2. Complete the test approval
3. Repeat and fail the approval
CAL-12.Expected result: A completed approval pays the balance. A failed approval leaves the balance due with a clear message.

CAL-13.Steps:
1. Choose Other
2. Enter how you were paid (for example Venmo)
3. Save payment
CAL-13.Expected result: The method is saved as written and counts as Recorded only with no fee.
CAL-13.Edge cases to try: Empty method text; very long text

CAL-14.Steps:
1. Open pay for an appointment at a salon-collects location
2. Record that the salon received it
CAL-14.Expected result: The payment is tracked with no Mova fee and shows under Collected by salons.
CAL-14.Edge cases to try: Switch the location's collector then reopen
CAL-14.Setup and test data: A location set to Salon collects

CAL-15.Flow: Pay the balance after a deposit
CAL-15.Steps:
1. Book with a deposit (BKG-07)
2. Open Record pay at the visit
3. Pay the remaining balance by cash, then repeat with card on another booking
CAL-15.Expected result: Only the balance is asked for. Total paid equals the service value.
CAL-15.Edge cases to try: Tip or extra amount; partial payment

CAL-16.Steps:
1. Open Money for this month
2. Compare Processed by Stripe, Recorded by you and Collected by salons with what you paid
3. Check the Mova fee and estimate to you
CAL-16.Expected result: Totals match each test payment. The Mova fee is 1.5% on Stripe payments only and zero on cash. The estimate carries its disclaimer.
CAL-16.Edge cases to try: Change month; month with no activity
CAL-16.Setup and test data: All payments from CAL-08 to CAL-15

CAL-17.Steps:
1. Look for a way to refund a Stripe payment
2. If it exists, refund part and then all
CAL-17.Expected result: Confirm whether a refund action exists. If it does, the refund shows in Money and on the appointment.
CAL-17.Setup and test data: Needs a paid Stripe test payment

CAL-18.Steps:
1. Open Home
2. Check Today, Needs you and This week
3. Open an item
CAL-18.Expected result: Counts and times are correct and each item opens the right appointment or request.

CAL-19.Steps:
1. Create a booking, a cancel and a no-show
2. Open Notifications
CAL-19.Expected result: Each event shows once with the right wording and opens the related item.

BKG-01.Steps:
1. Open the stylist's link while signed out
2. Look at the profile, services and portfolio
3. Choose Book
BKG-01.Expected result: Profile, services and prices load. Book leads to the booking page. Works on a phone and a desktop.
BKG-01.Edge cases to try: Unknown handle; stylist with no services; slow connection

BKG-02.Flow: Book an appointment that confirms instantly
BKG-02.Steps:
1. Choose a service
2. Pick a day and time
3. Enter name, phone or email
4. Choose communication options
5. Confirm
BKG-02.Expected result: The client sees a confirmation and gets a message. The appointment shows on the stylist's calendar and Home.
BKG-02.Edge cases to try: Back and change the time; leave a required field empty; double-tap Confirm
BKG-02.Setup and test data: A location set to instant booking

BKG-03.Steps:
1. Choose a service
2. Add another service
3. Pick a time
4. Confirm
BKG-03.Expected result: Total duration and price add up. The time offered fits the combined length.
BKG-03.Edge cases to try: Services that do not fit before closing

BKG-04.Flow: Book at a location that needs approval
BKG-04.Steps:
1. Book at a location set to request
2. Add a note and an alternate time
3. Submit
BKG-04.Expected result: The client sees that this is a request and is not confirmed. The stylist gets it under Needs you.
BKG-04.Edge cases to try: No alternate time; request left until it expires
BKG-04.Setup and test data: A location set to Stylist confirms

BKG-05.Steps:
1. Open Home
2. Open the request under Needs you
3. Choose Accept
BKG-05.Expected result: The appointment is confirmed, shows on the calendar, and the client is told.
BKG-05.Edge cases to try: Accept after another booking took the time; accept the alternate time

BKG-06.Expected result: The request closes and the client is told. The time opens up again.

BKG-07.Flow: Pay a deposit at booking with a test card
BKG-07.Steps:
1. Book a service that needs a deposit
2. Enter test card 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future date, any CVC and ZIP
3. Pay
BKG-07.Expected result: The deposit is charged in test mode and the booking is confirmed. The appointment shows the deposit as paid.
BKG-07.Edge cases to try: Close the tab during payment; refresh after paying; go back after paying
BKG-07.Setup and test data: Service with a deposit and a connected Stripe test account

BKG-08.Flow: Deposit card is declined or needs extra approval
BKG-08.Steps:
1. Pay with 4000 0000 0000 0002 (declined)
2. Pay with 4000 0025 0000 3155 (needs approval) and complete the check
3. Try again with 4242 4242 4242 4242
BKG-08.Expected result: A decline shows a clear message and the booking is not confirmed. The approval card completes after the check. A retry works.
BKG-08.Edge cases to try: Expired card; wrong CVC; abandon the 3D Secure window

BKG-09.Flow: Blocked time and hours are respected
BKG-09.Steps:
1. Open the booking page for a day the stylist blocked
2. Open a closed day
3. Open today within the minimum notice
BKG-09.Expected result: No times are offered for blocked, closed or too-soon times.
BKG-09.Edge cases to try: Block added while a client is mid-booking

BKG-10.Steps: 1. Pick a date range with no openings
BKG-10.Expected result: A No online times available message shows with a way to try another day.

BKG-11.Flow: Manage a booking from the link
BKG-11.Steps:
1. Open the manage link from the confirmation
2. View details
3. Reschedule to a new time
BKG-11.Expected result: The client sees the appointment and can pick another open time. The stylist's calendar updates.
BKG-11.Edge cases to try: Reschedule to a taken time; open after the visit

BKG-12.Flow: Cancel a booking from the link
BKG-12.Steps:
1. Open the manage link
2. Cancel the booking
3. Confirm
BKG-12.Expected result: The appointment is cancelled, the time opens, and the stylist is told. A deposit follows the cancel rules.
BKG-12.Edge cases to try: Cancel close to the start time; cancel twice
BKG-12.Setup and test data: A booking with a paid deposit

BKG-13.Steps:
1. Turn the review email and marketing choices on and off
2. Book
3. Check the client's contact preferences
BKG-13.Expected result: The client's choices are saved on their profile and respected afterward.

BKG-14.Steps:
1. Open a slot offer link
2. Choose Claim this spot
BKG-14.Expected result: The client is booked, or the request is sent when approval is needed. A confirmation shows.
BKG-14.Edge cases to try: Two clients claim at once; open after it was taken
BKG-14.Setup and test data: A cancelled appointment that created an open slot

BKG-15.Flow: Slot offer that is taken or ended
BKG-15.Steps:
1. Open an offer after another client took it
2. Open a made-up link
BKG-15.Expected result: Clear messages explain that the spot is taken, ended or the link is not valid, with other times shown.

BKG-16.Flow: Leave a review after a visit
BKG-16.Steps:
1. Open the review link
2. Pick stars, tags and a comment
3. Submit
BKG-16.Expected result: The review is saved and shown to the stylist. Only completed visits can review.
BKG-16.Edge cases to try: No star rating; link reused; link for an unfinished visit

BKG-17.Steps:
1. Open Reviews
2. Reply to a review
3. Edit the reply
BKG-17.Expected result: The reply saves and shows under the review.

BKG-18.Flow: Book again from the client profile
BKG-18.Steps:
1. Sign in as the client
2. Open a past appointment
3. Choose Book again
BKG-18.Expected result: The booking page opens for the same stylist and service.
BKG-18.Edge cases to try: Stylist who no longer offers the service

MKT-01.Flow: Open Marketing for the first time
MKT-01.Steps:
1. Open Growth, then Marketing
2. Read the intro and channels
MKT-01.Expected result: A clear first screen with a Create a campaign button. No campaigns yet. Channels that are not set up say so.
MKT-01.Edge cases to try: Free plan stylist; stylist with no clients

MKT-02.Steps:
1. Choose Create a campaign
2. Name it and pick a goal: fill an opening, invite clients to rebook, or promote an offer
3. Pick who should receive it
4. Write or edit the message
5. Save the draft
MKT-02.Expected result: The draft appears in the list with its goal, audience and message. Nothing is sent.
MKT-02.Edge cases to try: Empty name; very long message; each goal; each audience

MKT-03.Steps:
1. Open the audience step
2. Compare Everyone who consented, Lapsed, Recent and Upcoming
3. Review the count and who is left out
MKT-03.Expected result: Counts match the client list. Only clients who opted in appear. Imported and opted-out clients are never included.
MKT-03.Edge cases to try: Client who opted out after the draft; client with no contact details
MKT-03.Setup and test data: Clients with mixed consent from the Setup tab

MKT-04.Steps:
1. Open a draft
2. Choose Edit draft
3. Change the message and audience
4. Save
MKT-04.Expected result: Changes are saved and the list updates.

MKT-05.Steps:
1. Open a draft
2. Choose Cancel and confirm
MKT-05.Expected result: The draft is removed or marked cancelled and cannot be sent.

MKT-06.Steps:
1. Sign in as a Free stylist
2. Open Marketing
3. Repeat as Pro and as AI + Growth
MKT-06.Expected result: Free sees a clear upgrade message. Pro and above can create campaigns. Wording matches the plan page.
MKT-06.Setup and test data: One account per plan in test mode

MKT-07.Steps:
1. Try to send or schedule a campaign
2. Check the client's inbox and phone
MKT-07.Expected result: While delivery is not approved, nothing is sent and the screen explains why. No client receives anything.
MKT-07.Edge cases to try: Send to yourself as a client; retry many times
MKT-07.Setup and test data: A client with your own email

MKT-08.Steps:
1. Opt a client out of marketing
2. Rebuild the audience
MKT-08.Expected result: The client leaves the audience count and cannot be targeted.

AI-01.Steps:
1. Open Growth
2. Check the revenue forecast and the links to pipeline, win back, slots, autopilot, messages, activity and concierge
AI-01.Expected result: Every link opens the right page. Forecast shows a note when there are fewer than three months of history.
AI-01.Edge cases to try: New stylist with no history; stylist with a lot of history

AI-02.Steps:
1. Open Pipeline
2. Read Due, Contacted and Rebooked
3. Choose Refresh pipeline
AI-02.Expected result: The list shows clients due for a visit with a confidence level. Refresh shows a success or error message.

AI-03.Steps:
1. Open Win back
2. Look for a client who has not visited in a while
3. Try the Send button
AI-03.Expected result: Each win-back needs a tap from the stylist. Send is off until approvals are complete and the screen says so.
AI-03.Edge cases to try: A client who already rebooked; an opted-out client

AI-04.Steps:
1. Open Autopilot
2. Change the daily cap and days between reminders
3. Save rules
4. Turn the switch off and on
AI-04.Expected result: Rules save and show in the summary. Autopilot stays off while approvals are missing.

AI-05.Steps:
1. Open the templates
2. Edit a rebooking reminder, slot offer, slot taken and win-back message in English
3. Save
AI-05.Expected result: Each template saves and shows Needs approval, Approved or Paused.

AI-06.Steps:
1. Open Activity
2. Filter by sent, skipped, held, failed and rebooked
AI-06.Expected result: Rows show the action, reason, date and value, and the filter works.

AI-07.Flow: Fill an open slot after a cancel
AI-07.Steps:
1. Cancel or no-show an appointment
2. Open Fill open slots
3. Offer the slot to waiting clients
4. As a client open the link and claim it
AI-07.Expected result: The slot is offered, one client gets it, and the stylist's calendar updates. Others see the spot is taken.
AI-07.Edge cases to try: Two clients claim together; offer expires

AI-08.Steps:
1. Open Concierge
2. Read Needs you, Handled today and Appointments booked
3. Open a conversation
AI-08.Expected result: Counts and conversations match. An empty inbox says nothing needs you.

AI-09.Steps:
1. Open Setup
2. Add a question and an answer in English
3. Save information
4. Use Pause concierge everywhere
AI-09.Expected result: The answer saves and pausing is shown clearly.

AI-10.Steps:
1. Send a message to the stylist from a client
2. Watch for a reply
AI-10.Expected result: No AI reply is sent while approvals are pending. The screen says replies are unavailable.
AI-10.Setup and test data: A client message through the page chat

AI-11.Steps:
1. Open PricePilot
2. Review the price position of each service
3. Check a service's low to high range and suggested price
AI-11.Expected result: Every active service is listed with where it sits against nearby prices. Thin data shows a clear message instead of a guess.
AI-11.Edge cases to try: Stylist with no ZIP; stylist with one service
AI-11.Setup and test data: Needs the PricePilot redesign before testing

AI-12.Steps:
1. Open Reviews
2. Filter reviews
3. Turn review requests on and off
AI-12.Expected result: Reviews list and settings save. Review requests go only after a completed visit with consent.

ONB-01.Steps:
1. Open /signup
2. Enter a new email and a password that meets the hint
3. Submit
ONB-01.Expected result: Account is created and the stylist is taken to email verification or onboarding step 2. No error shown.
ONB-01.Edge cases to try: Existing email; invalid email; password too short; double-tap submit; spaces around the email
ONB-01.Setup and test data: A fresh email, for example name+test1@gmail.com

ONB-02.Steps:
1. Open /signup
2. Submit with empty fields
3. Submit with a password that breaks the rule
4. Submit with an email already in use
ONB-02.Expected result: Each problem shows a clear message next to the field or form. Nothing is created. The form keeps what was typed.
ONB-02.Edge cases to try: Paste a very long email; use an emoji in the password; go offline and submit
ONB-02.Setup and test data: One existing account and one fresh email

ONB-03.Steps:
1. Open /login
2. Enter email and password
3. Submit
ONB-03.Expected result: Stylist lands on Home for their business. A stylist who has not finished onboarding resumes at the right step.
ONB-03.Edge cases to try: Return-to link (open a protected page while signed out, then sign in); browser back after sign in
ONB-03.Setup and test data: A finished stylist account and an unfinished one

ONB-04.Steps:
1. Enter a correct email and a wrong password
2. Submit
3. Try an email that has no account
ONB-04.Expected result: A single clear error appears and the password field is cleared or focused. The message does not reveal whether the email exists.
ONB-04.Edge cases to try: Five wrong tries in a row; caps lock on; email with different capitalization

ONB-05.Steps:
1. On /login choose Forgot password
2. Enter the account email and submit
3. Open the email link
4. Set a new password
5. Sign in with it
ONB-05.Expected result: Confirmation is shown after step 2. The link opens the new-password form. The new password works and the old one does not.
ONB-05.Edge cases to try: Expired or reused link; password that breaks the rule; request for an email with no account

ONB-06.Steps:
1. Enter display name
2. Choose a handle and wait for the availability message
3. Add 1 to 5 specialties
4. Add an optional bio
5. Continue
ONB-06.Expected result: Continue stays disabled until the handle is available and at least one specialty is added. After continuing, the stylist is on the photo step.
ONB-06.Edge cases to try: 6th specialty; bio over 500 characters; name with accents; closing the tab and coming back

ONB-07.Steps:
1. Type a handle that is free
2. Type one already taken
3. Type invalid ones: too short, capitals, spaces, symbols
ONB-07.Expected result: Free handle shows Available. Taken or invalid handles show a specific reason and block Continue.
ONB-07.Edge cases to try: Reserved words such as admin; 2 and 31 characters; trailing hyphen; rapid typing
ONB-07.Setup and test data: A second stylist account that owns a handle

ONB-08.Steps:
1. Choose a photo (and separately try Take photo)
2. Adjust the zoom
3. Choose Use photo
ONB-08.Expected result: Preview shows with the zoom applied. The upload succeeds and the stylist moves to services.
ONB-08.Edge cases to try: File over 10 MB; HEIC photo; unsupported file type; cancel the camera; upload with a weak connection
ONB-08.Setup and test data: Photos: JPG, PNG, HEIC, one over 10 MB

ONB-09.Steps: 1. Choose Later without picking a photo
ONB-09.Expected result: The stylist moves on to services with no photo. A placeholder shows on their profile until one is added.
ONB-09.Edge cases to try: Skip, then finish onboarding and check the public profile

ONB-10.Steps:
1. Enter name, category, duration, buffer and price
2. Optionally add a deposit (fixed or percent)
3. Save the service
4. Continue
ONB-10.Expected result: The service appears in the list with duration, price and deposit. Continue goes to the publish step.
ONB-10.Edge cases to try: Add two services; deposit larger than the price; price with cents; no services then Continue
ONB-10.Setup and test data: Example: Silk press, Hair, 90 min, 15 min buffer, $95

ONB-11.Steps:
1. Leave required fields empty and save
2. Enter a price like 12.345 or letters
3. Enter a duration of 0 or 2000
ONB-11.Expected result: Each invalid value is refused with a clear message. Nothing is saved.
ONB-11.Edge cases to try: Negative numbers; very long service name; duplicate service names

ONB-12.Steps:
1. Review the summary
2. Choose whether the profile can appear in search
3. Publish
ONB-12.Expected result: The profile is published and the stylist lands on Home. The public page at /a/handle loads with their services.
ONB-12.Edge cases to try: Publish twice quickly; publish with search off; open the public page signed out

ONB-13.Steps:
1. Start onboarding and stop after the photo step
2. Close the browser
3. Sign in again
ONB-13.Expected result: The stylist returns to the step where they stopped, with their earlier answers kept.
ONB-13.Edge cases to try: Open a later step by URL before finishing the earlier one; use a second device

ONB-14.Steps:
1. Sign in with a finished account
2. Open /onboarding/profile by URL
ONB-14.Expected result: The stylist is sent to Home and does not see step 1 again.

ONB-15.Steps:
1. Choose Sign out on any onboarding step
2. Sign in again
ONB-15.Expected result: Session ends and the stylist returns to sign in. Progress is kept.
ONB-15.Edge cases to try: Sign out in one tab while another is open

ONB-16.Flow: Switch between stylist and client sign in
ONB-16.Steps:
1. On the stylist sign-in page choose the client link
2. Use the link back to stylist sign in
ONB-16.Expected result: Each link goes to the right sign-in page and the layout and wording match the persona.

ONB-17.Steps:
1. Open /signin
2. Enter the email or phone the client booked with
3. Enter the code that arrives
ONB-17.Expected result: The client lands on their profile at /me. Their upcoming appointments are listed.
ONB-17.Edge cases to try: Wrong code; expired code; request a new code; email with capitals
ONB-17.Setup and test data: A client with at least one past booking

ONB-18.Expected result: The client can keep going without an account and is not asked to sign in again on the booking page.

ONB-19.Steps:
1. Sign in
2. Choose Claim past bookings
3. Confirm
ONB-19.Expected result: Earlier bookings made as a guest appear under the account. No one else's bookings appear.
ONB-19.Edge cases to try: Booking made with a different email; claim twice
ONB-19.Setup and test data: Guest booking made with the same contact

ONB-20.Steps:
1. Open the client card link a stylist shared
2. Review upcoming appointments
3. Choose Book with this stylist
ONB-20.Expected result: The card shows the stylist, the client and upcoming visits. Book goes to the stylist's booking page.
ONB-20.Edge cases to try: Client with no upcoming visits; open on a phone and a desktop
ONB-20.Setup and test data: A stylist account with a client card token

ONB-21.Steps:
1. Open /c/ with a made-up token
2. Open a link from a deleted client
ONB-21.Expected result: A friendly unavailable message appears with no client details shown.
ONB-21.Edge cases to try: Token with extra characters; very long token

ONB-22.Flow: Arrive from a stylist QR code
ONB-22.Steps:
1. Scan or open the stylist's QR link
2. View the stylist's page
3. Choose Book
ONB-22.Expected result: The client sees the right stylist and can start a booking without signing in first.
ONB-22.Edge cases to try: Handle with capitals; handle that does not exist; QR opened in a social app browser
ONB-22.Setup and test data: The stylist's QR code from Show my QR

ONB-23.Steps:
1. Edit details
2. Turn appointment texts on and off
3. Turn marketing email on and off
ONB-23.Expected result: Changes save and are still there after a reload.
ONB-23.Edge cases to try: Clear a required field; change email

ONB-24.Steps:
1. Choose Delete profile
2. Read the warning
3. Enter the code that is sent
4. Confirm
ONB-24.Expected result: The profile is removed after the code is confirmed. The client is signed out and cannot sign in with the old details.
ONB-24.Edge cases to try: Wrong code; cancel at the warning; delete with upcoming appointments

SET-01.Flow: Add a location with weekly hours
SET-01.Steps:
1. Open Settings, then Locations, then Add location
2. Choose the type (suite, booth, salon, home studio, mobile)
3. Set name, address, time zone and weekly hours
4. Choose instant or request booking and who collects payment
5. Save
SET-01.Expected result: The location is saved as Active and shows its hours, notice and who collects payment. The calendar opens for booking at that location.
SET-01.Edge cases to try: Closing time before opening; a closed day; two locations; minimum notice 0; booking horizon very long

SET-02.Steps:
1. Open an existing location
2. Change hours or booking mode
3. Save
4. Switch it to inactive
SET-02.Expected result: Changes show on the list. An inactive location offers no times on the booking page.
SET-02.Edge cases to try: Deactivate the only location; location with future appointments
SET-02.Setup and test data: A location with an upcoming appointment

SET-03.Steps:
1. Open Settings, then Services
2. Choose Add
3. Enter name, category, duration, buffer and price
4. Optionally turn on Require a deposit and pick $ or %
5. Set a different price at a location if wanted
6. Save service
SET-03.Expected result: The service appears in the list with price, duration, deposit and a Shown on booking page chip. It is bookable on the public page.
SET-03.Edge cases to try: Blank name; price 0; deposit above price; percent over 100; two locations with different prices
SET-03.Setup and test data: Example: Knotless braids, Hair, 240 min, $220, 25% deposit

SET-04.Steps:
1. Choose Edit on a service
2. Change price and duration
3. Turn Bookable off
4. Save
SET-04.Expected result: The list updates. A service that is not bookable disappears from the booking page but old appointments keep their price.
SET-04.Edge cases to try: Change a price with future appointments; cancel the form with unsaved changes

SET-05.Steps:
1. Choose Deactivate on a service
2. Check the public booking page
SET-05.Expected result: The service shows as inactive and clients cannot book it.

SET-06.Steps:
1. Open Clients, then Add client
2. Enter name and phone or email
3. Save
